globalInvariants: Every persistent operation has an idempotency key, transaction ID and support-visible audit result.
Client uncertainty is represented as pending reconciliation rather than guessed success or failure.
Permanent economy and entitlement state is server authoritative.
Ad and login eligibility/grants bind immutable accepted configuration versions.
Refund/revocation deficit is explicit, auditable and never resolved by silently consuming unrelated free value.
